faqs.q: How are businesses chosen for the Cincinnati Aesthetics guide?
faqs.a: We hand-pick and curate the best med spas and aesthetics providers in Greater Cincinnati based on quality, reputation, and community feedback.

faqs.q: How do I get my med spa featured?
faqs.a: Contact us about featured placements — we offer website exposure and inclusion in our print guide.

faqs.q: Is the guide free to use?
faqs.a: Yes, browsing the directory is completely free. Businesses pay for featured placement.
